column2: [FR-09] Percent coupon inverts the discount formula and bills the customer ten times the order total
[FR-05] Product search interpolates the term directly into SQL (injection; `%` and `_` act as wildcards)
[FR-05] The search term is rendered as HTML, so injected JavaScript executes (XSS)
[FR-14] Category write endpoints accept any authenticated user; the admin role is never checked
[FR-09] `/api/apply-coupon` requires no authentication, which also defeats the per-user usage limit
[FR-09] A total exactly equal to `min_order_amount` is refused (threshold is exclusive)
[FR-14] A category name is never validated: empty and whitespace-only names are stored
[FR-14] Deleting a category leaves its products pointing at a category that no longer exists
[FR-05] A search that matches nothing shows no empty-state message
[FR-05] Prices are rendered as `VND` instead of the required `₫`
[FR-05] The home page has two `<h1>` elements
[FR-05] Every product image has an empty `alt` attribute
[FR-05] No loading indicator while products are being fetched
